description:
About the job

Futurum ya tiene una base desde la cual crecer: más de siete años de operación, programas educativos rentables, miles de alumnos atendidos y una plataforma propia con IA. Hasta ahora, growth ha sido operado directamente por los founders. Buscamos a la persona que tome esa experiencia y construya una operación de growth repetible, medible y cada vez más automatizada.




El reto empieza en México. Primero queremos mejorar el funnel de nuestros programas y validar la suscripción de la plataforma. Después queremos convertir lo aprendido en un playbook que nos permita llevar Futurum a más estudiantes de Latinoamérica.




Es un rol hands-on. Tendrás acceso directo al CEO, trabajarás cerca del CTO y podrás tomar decisiones sobre todo el funnel. Vas a encontrar tracción, conocimiento del mercado y productos que ya operan. También encontrarás datos fragmentados, procesos manuales y muchas oportunidades que todavía necesitan a alguien que las convierta en proyectos terminados.




Si te interesa entrar a una startup donde todavía puedes construir, experimentar y dejar tu forma de trabajar dentro de la empresa, probablemente hagas buen fit.




Sobre Futurum

Futurum es una startup mexicana de tecnología educativa para estudiantes que buscan entrar y avanzar en carreras de salud. Durante los últimos cuatro años, de cada 10 estudiantes que entraron a medicina en la UAQ, 5 pasaron por Futurum.




También construimos una plataforma propia con IA que hoy utilizan activamente 2,000 alumnos. El siguiente paso es validar su modelo de suscripción para estudiantes de medicina y después llevarlo a nuevos mercados.




Somos un equipo pequeño que trabaja desde Querétaro. Nos gusta probar rápido, medir y cambiar de decisión cuando los datos lo piden. Buscamos a alguien que quiera trabajar con esa libertad y también con la responsabilidad que viene con ella.




What you’ll own

Tendrás responsabilidad sobre el funnel end-to-end: adquisición, conversación, pago, uso y recompra. El objetivo es construir una operación que genere crecimiento y que dependa cada vez menos de seguimiento manual.




Durante tus primeros seis meses avanzarás en este orden:

Corregir y operar el funnel de nuestros programas.
Tomar ownership de paid media, landing pages y creativos.
Automatizar la operación comercial con IA.
Construir el funnel de suscripción de la plataforma.




Esperamos foco. Cada etapa deberá dejar procesos funcionando y aprendizajes que permitan decidir el siguiente paso.




What you’ll do

Operar el funnel desde adquisición hasta pago, uso y recompra.
Administrar Meta Ads end-to-end: campañas, presupuesto, optimización y resultados.
Entender cómo compran nuestros alumnos. Esto incluye responder y cerrar leads por WhatsApp cuando haga falta.
Convertir ese conocimiento comercial en mejores mensajes, automatizaciones y agentes.
Construir agentes para captar, calificar, dar seguimiento y reactivar leads.
Conectar Meta Ads, CRM, WhatsApp, pagos y producto mediante APIs y webhooks.
Crear workflows con n8n, Make, Zapier, modelos de lenguaje o código ligero.
Diseñar procesos human-in-the-loop, con evaluaciones, seguimiento de errores y rutas de escalamiento.
Lanzar experimentos en campañas, mensajes, landing pages, ofertas y procesos de venta.
Documentar cada experimento con hipótesis, métrica, resultado y siguiente decisión.
Construir dashboards que ayuden a decidir dónde invertir tiempo y presupuesto.
Crear prototipos de anuncios, landings y flujos con herramientas de IA.
Coordinar freelancers o agencias cuando una ejecución necesite apoyo especializado.
Trabajar con el CTO para definir qué debemos medir dentro del producto. El código de la plataforma seguirá bajo su responsabilidad.




Al inicio propondrás el gasto de las campañas. Conforme demuestres resultados, podrás operar con autonomía dentro de un presupuesto acordado.




What success looks like

Durante tus primeros 90 días esperamos que entiendas el funnel completo, identifiques dónde perdemos leads, pagos o información y construyas una baseline de las métricas disponibles.




También queremos ver automatizaciones comerciales en producción, una forma confiable de conectar adquisición con conversación y pago, y experimentos que terminen en decisiones. Al cerrar este periodo deberás contar con dashboards separados para programas y suscripción, además de un roadmap de growth para los siguientes seis meses.




Las primeras metas numéricas se fijarán en enero de 2027. Antes necesitamos medir bien el punto de partida.




Haces buen fit si

Tienes high agency y sabes avanzar con objetivos abiertos.
Has llevado proyectos de 0 a 1 y puedes mostrar lo que construiste.
Puedes explicar con claridad qué parte hiciste tú y qué resultado produjo.
Has operado funnels de growth, marketing o ventas.
Tienes experiencia práctica con paid media, CRM, landing pages y analytics.
Ya usaste IA para construir agentes, herramientas o automatizaciones que otras personas utilizaron.
Puedes conectar herramientas mediante APIs y webhooks.
Te sientes cómodo leyendo, adaptando o escribiendo código ligero.
Sabes trabajar con hipótesis, métricas y decisiones.
Entiendes que un proyecto de growth debe terminar conectado con revenue.
Puedes cuestionar una idea de los founders y sostener tu postura con información.
Tienes inglés B2 o superior.




Buscamos evidencia de ejecución. Queremos conocer proyectos que hayas llevado de inicio a fin, decisiones que hayas tomado y cosas que hayas aprendido después de lanzar.




La carrera universitaria es opcional. Haber trabajado en una startup suma. También suma haber construido un producto, negocio, funnel o herramienta por tu cuenta.




Extra points

Tener criterio visual puede ampliar mucho tu espacio de ejecución. Suma experiencia con Figma, Framer, Webflow, creative strategy, generación de imágenes, edición de video o motion.




Puedes hacer buen fit aunque diseño quede fuera de tu especialidad. En ese caso esperamos que puedas construir un prototipo, escribir un buen brief y coordinar el resultado con un freelancer o una agencia.




Lo que puedes construir aquí

Empezarás como individual contributor, sin personas a tu cargo. Tendrás espacio para diseñar cómo trabaja el área, escoger herramientas y proponer qué capacidades necesita el equipo. Conforme la función crezca, participarás con el CEO en la contratación y coordinación de nuevas personas.




El alcance del puesto puede crecer con los resultados. La dirección de largo plazo es llevar Futurum a más mercados de Latinoamérica. La siguiente etapa consiste en construir y probar ese playbook desde México.




Condiciones

$45,000 MXN brutos mensuales.
Prestaciones de ley.
Bono variable por resultados. El esquema se acordará antes de la contratación.
Presupuesto para las herramientas de software aprobadas que necesite el puesto.
Horario de lunes a viernes, de 9:00 a 18:00.
Modalidad presencial en Querétaro como primera opción.
Esquema híbrido negociable.
Podemos considerar trabajo remoto para un candidato excepcional.
Equipo de cómputo propio al comenzar.
Fecha ideal de entrada: 1 de octubre de 2026.




How to apply

Postúlate desde LinkedIn con tu CV. En esta primera etapa sólo necesitamos eso.




Si avanzas, te pediremos ejemplos de proyectos, funnels, experimentos o automatizaciones que hayas construido. Queremos entender qué hiciste tú, qué pusiste en producción, cómo mediste el resultado y qué aprendiste después.

About the job

The company focuses on building “legible” brands that are easy to find, understand, trust, and recommend across digital channels. Its work spans search, AI-powered answers, content, media, and end-to-end digital experiences for a diverse range of clients. Team members collaborate across disciplines to deliver measurable performance and innovative solutions. iCrossing offers opportunities to work with leading brands while developing skills at the intersection of marketing and technology.

Role Description The Digital Media Specialist Jr is a full-time, on-site role based in Mexico City, Mexico. This role supports the planning, execution, and optimization of digital media campaigns across channels such as social media, display, and search. Daily responsibilities include trafficking and monitoring campaigns, tracking performance metrics, and preparing reports using web analytics tools. The specialist collaborates with senior team members and account managers to align media tactics with clients’ marketing objectives and brand guidelines. The role also involves staying current with digital trends, assisting with content and creative asset coordination, and helping ensure campaigns are delivered on time and within budget.

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

title: AI Architect — Data, Automation & Intelligence Systems
skills: Act as Sarelly's internal expert on what AI can and can't realistically do, helping teams identify and prioritize high-value use cases.
Build a culture where teams bring business problems, not tool requests.
Create practical standards, reusable workflows and training so teams can safely use and build with AI while critical systems remain governed.
Own and maintain a prioritized roadmap of AI, automation and data opportunities based on business impact, feasibility and effort.

Ex Unify Sarelly's Inventory & Systems Data. Day One problem: Sarelly's inventory currently lives across disconnected systems — Shopify (website + offline stores in Mexico), two separate 3PL systems (MX and US), and Amazon (US and MX) — none of which talk to each other today.
Design and build the integration layer that connects these systems into a single source of truth for inventory.
Identify the next systems that should be integrated as the business grows.

Ensure AI-generated outputs retain links to underlying source evidence, expose confidence and coverage gaps, and can be reviewed or corrected by human experts.
Design the architecture so Sarelly owns its data and can connect it securely to Claude, ChatGPT or future AI models and agents without rebuilding the underlying system.

Over time, extend this infrastructure beyond Consumer Intelligence to broader Business Intelligence, connecting commercial performance, retail, market/category forecasts and competitive intelligence to support leadership and country GM decision-making
Map manual, repetitive or disconnected processes across the organization and determine where automation, integration or AI can create meaningful business value.
Own these automations end-to-end: build, test, deploy, monitor, and fix when they break.
Design and deploy Slack-based agents that give the team fast answers on things like regulatory questions and order status/tracking.
Identify other repeated, answerable questions across the org that an agent could handle reliably.
Help build a more robust demand planning and forecasting model.
Organize the underlying data correctly so forecasting is reliable, not ad hoc.
Automate recurring planning routines that are currently manual.
Connect internal performance data with relevant external market, category and competitive signals to improve forecasting and business decisions.
Partner with Finance, Sales and country GMs to identify recurring decisions that can be supported by better data, predictive models or AI-assisted analysis.
Build dashboards, alerts or AI-assisted decision tools where they create measurable value — not dashboards for the sake of reporting.
Proven experience shipping AI-powered automations, integrations, data products or internal tools in a live business environment — not just prototypes or experiments.
Hands-on experience connecting systems through APIs and building data pipelines across structured and unstructured internal and external sources.
Strong hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents beyond prompting, including orchestration, function calling, RAG, tool use, structured outputs or similar production workflows.
Strong understanding of AI quality and evaluation, including source traceability, confidence, human validation, error monitoring and failure modes.
Ability to design maintainable, model-agnostic systems, so critical data and workflows are not locked into a single AI model or vendor.
Strong technical judgment: you know when to use generative AI, deterministic automation, traditional analytics, predictive models or a simpler process solution.
Ability to translate messy business problems into practical technical solutions, prioritize based on business impact, and explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working directly with business teams to define requirements, build solutions, drive adoption and continuously improve them.
Fluent in English and Spanish.
Retail, e-commerce, supply chain or logistics technology, including Shopify, WMS/3PL systems, Amazon integrations, demand planning or forecasting.

Building production Slack, chat-based agents or other internal AI tools
Ships working automations, not proposals.
Is honest about what AI can't do yet, not just what it can.
Gets energized by messy, disconnected systems and wants to fix them.
Can work independently across multiple departments without losing focus.
Wants to build a capability — internal AI/automation — that doesn't fully exist at Sarelly yet.
Prioritize ruthlessly — focus on projects with clear, measurable operational impact.
description:
About the job

Location: Mexico (preferred) | Hybrid / Remote




About Sarelly

Sarelly is building more than a beauty brand — we're building an entertainment and culture-driven beauty company designed for the next generation of Latina consumers.




As we scale across Mexico and the U.S., we're investing in AI and data infrastructure as a core business capability — connecting the systems that run the business, automating repetitive work, and building intelligence systems that help our teams make faster, better decisions.




We're splitting what was originally a single "AI + Consumer Intelligence" hire into two focused roles. This posting is for the technical / operational half: the person who architects and builds Sarelly's automation and AI agent capability across the business. A separate Consumer Intelligence Lead will own the consumer questions, taxonomy, insight validation and translation into Product, Brand and Growth decisions. This role will partner closely with them to build the data collection, infrastructure and AI workflows that make that intelligence possible.




The Opportunity

This is not a traditional IT, data engineering, or "prompt engineer" role.

You'll architect the data and intelligence infrastructure behind Sarelly's decision-making: connecting internal business data with selected external market, consumer and competitive signals, and building systems that can turn that data into reliable, traceable intelligence




You'll be Sarelly's internal AI Champion: the person who knows what's actually possible with today's AI tools, pushes back when it isn't, and educates the rest of the organization so people stop guessing. You'll also be hands-on — designing and shipping the automations, integrations and agents that remove manual work across Operations, Logistics, HR and beyond.




Your mission: build the data, automation and AI infrastructure that makes Sarelly smarter and more efficient — connecting fragmented systems, eliminating repetitive work, and transforming internal and external data into reliable intelligence teams can act on.




You'll report into the COO's org and work directly with department heads (Supply Chain, Finance, Sales and Marketing) to find, prioritize and build these projects.




Key ResponsibilitiesBe Sarelly's AI Champion
Act as Sarelly's internal expert on what AI can and can't realistically do, helping teams identify and prioritize high-value use cases.
Build a culture where teams bring business problems, not tool requests.
Create practical standards, reusable workflows and training so teams can safely use and build with AI while critical systems remain governed.
Own and maintain a prioritized roadmap of AI, automation and data opportunities based on business impact, feasibility and effort.




Build Sarelly's Connected Data Foundation
Ex Unify Sarelly's Inventory & Systems Data. Day One problem: Sarelly's inventory currently lives across disconnected systems — Shopify (website + offline stores in Mexico), two separate 3PL systems (MX and US), and Amazon (US and MX) — none of which talk to each other today.
Design and build the integration layer that connects these systems into a single source of truth for inventory.
Identify the next systems that should be integrated as the business grows.




Build Sarelly's Intelligence Infrastructure

Partner with the Consumer Intelligence Lead to build the technical foundation of Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence Hub.
Design data collection pipelines across selected public and first-party sources, including social platforms, retailers, competitors, creators/influencers, customer feedback, commerce and CRM.
Build systems capable of continuously transforming large volumes of unstructured data into structured, searchable intelligence using Sarelly-defined taxonomies.
Ensure AI-generated outputs retain links to underlying source evidence, expose confidence and coverage gaps, and can be reviewed or corrected by human experts.
Design the architecture so Sarelly owns its data and can connect it securely to Claude, ChatGPT or future AI models and agents without rebuilding the underlying system.
Over time, extend this infrastructure beyond Consumer Intelligence to broader Business Intelligence, connecting commercial performance, retail, market/category forecasts and competitive intelligence to support leadership and country GM decision-making




Build Automations, Agents & Internal Tools
Map manual, repetitive or disconnected processes across the organization and determine where automation, integration or AI can create meaningful business value.
Own these automations end-to-end: build, test, deploy, monitor, and fix when they break.
Design and deploy Slack-based agents that give the team fast answers on things like regulatory questions and order status/tracking.
Identify other repeated, answerable questions across the org that an agent could handle reliably.




Build Business Intelligence & Forecasting Capabilities
Help build a more robust demand planning and forecasting model.
Organize the underlying data correctly so forecasting is reliable, not ad hoc.
Automate recurring planning routines that are currently manual.
Connect internal performance data with relevant external market, category and competitive signals to improve forecasting and business decisions.
Partner with Finance, Sales and country GMs to identify recurring decisions that can be supported by better data, predictive models or AI-assisted analysis.
Build dashboards, alerts or AI-assisted decision tools where they create measurable value — not dashboards for the sake of reporting.




What you bring 
Proven experience shipping AI-powered automations, integrations, data products or internal tools in a live business environment — not just prototypes or experiments.
Hands-on experience connecting systems through APIs and building data pipelines across structured and unstructured internal and external sources.
Strong hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents beyond prompting, including orchestration, function calling, RAG, tool use, structured outputs or similar production workflows.
Strong understanding of AI quality and evaluation, including source traceability, confidence, human validation, error monitoring and failure modes.
Ability to design maintainable, model-agnostic systems, so critical data and workflows are not locked into a single AI model or vendor.
Strong technical judgment: you know when to use generative AI, deterministic automation, traditional analytics, predictive models or a simpler process solution.
Ability to translate messy business problems into practical technical solutions, prioritize based on business impact, and explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working directly with business teams to define requirements, build solutions, drive adoption and continuously improve them.
Fluent in English and Spanish.




Preferred Experience

Strong preference for candidates with experience in one or more of the following:




Retail, e-commerce, supply chain or logistics technology, including Shopify, WMS/3PL systems, Amazon integrations, demand planning or forecasting.
Workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Zapier, Make or Retool.
Business Intelligence and data visualization, including dashboards, predictive models or decision-support tools.
Building production Slack, chat-based agents or other internal AI tools




Mindset

We're looking for someone who:




Ships working automations, not proposals.
Is honest about what AI can't do yet, not just what it can.
Gets energized by messy, disconnected systems and wants to fix them.
Can work independently across multiple departments without losing focus.
Wants to build a capability — internal AI/automation — that doesn't fully exist at Sarelly yet.
Prioritize ruthlessly — focus on projects with clear, measurable operational impact.




Why Join Sarelly?

This is a rare opportunity to build Sarelly's internal data, AI and automation capability from the ground up — not as a side initiative, but as core infrastructure the whole company will run on. You'll have direct visibility into Supply Chain, Retail, Logistics, Customer Service and HR, and the mandate to fix real operational problems with real tools, fast.

description:
About the job

Estamos construyendo una plataforma de estudio que acompañe a estudiantes de carreras de salud en toda Latinoamérica. Futurum lleva más de siete años desarrollando programas educativos y hoy tenemos una plataforma con IA en beta que ya utilizan alumnos dentro de nuestros programas.




Ahora viene una etapa difícil y emocionante: mejorar el producto, integrar agentes, automatizar la operación y descubrir qué necesitamos para crecer. Somos un equipo joven y hands-on. Trabajarás cerca de los fundadores, las decisiones se toman rápido y podrás ver el impacto de lo que construyes.




What you’ll own

Aproximadamente 60% de tu tiempo estará enfocado en producto y 40% en automatizaciones internas. Reportarás directamente a Eduardo, nuestro cofundador y CTO. Él define la dirección tecnológica y las prioridades. Tú tendrás ownership sobre cómo llevarlas a producción.




Serás responsable de features end to end: entender el problema, investigar opciones, proponer una solución, construirla y darle seguimiento después del release. Conforme conozcas el producto y demuestres criterio en tus decisiones, tendrás mayor autonomía sobre arquitectura, herramientas e implementación.




Comenzarás como individual contributor. A medida que Futurum crezca, podrás ayudarnos a formar el equipo tech y participar en decisiones cada vez más importantes.




What you’ll do

Desarrollar funcionalidades de frontend y backend para la plataforma.
Mejorar la confiabilidad de las funciones actuales con IA.
Diseñar e integrar agentes de IA dentro de la experiencia del alumno.
Mejorar la interfaz y reducir fricciones dentro del producto.
Automatizar procesos de ventas, empezando por el seguimiento de leads.
Crear herramientas que reduzcan el trabajo manual del equipo académico.
Conectar APIs, webhooks, bases de datos y herramientas externas.
Escribir pruebas, monitorear releases y mantener lo que llevas a producción.
Documentar decisiones técnicas para que el conocimiento se quede en el equipo.
Investigar nuevas herramientas de IA y proponer aplicaciones concretas para Futurum.




Hoy trabajamos con React, TypeScript, Supabase, SQL, AWS, Vercel, Claude, n8n y Make. El stack seguirá evolucionando conforme avance el producto.




What success looks like

Durante tus primeros 90 días esperamos que entiendas la arquitectura actual, hagas tus primeros releases y puedas tomar ownership de una mejora completa. Tus primeras entregas pueden incluir estabilizar un flujo con IA, integrar un agente, mejorar una parte importante de la interfaz o llevar una automatización interna a producción.




Después de seis meses deberías poder construir features end to end con poca supervisión, proponer decisiones técnicas con buenos argumentos y detectar oportunidades de automatización dentro del equipo. También esperamos que comuniques los tradeoffs de cada solución, señales riesgos a tiempo y mantengas la calidad de lo que ya construiste.




Trabajarás con problemas abiertos y prioridades que pueden evolucionar. Algunas respuestas todavía no existen. Esperamos que puedas investigar, hacer buenas preguntas y avanzar con la información disponible. Ahí está gran parte del reto y también la oportunidad de dejar tu huella en el producto.

The basics

El puesto es de tiempo completo, con un sueldo de $45,000 MXN brutos mensuales y prestaciones de ley. Futurum cubrirá las herramientas de software que necesites para trabajar.




Preferimos que estés presencialmente en Querétaro, aunque podemos acordar un esquema híbrido y considerar trabajo remoto para un candidato excepcional. La fecha ideal de entrada es el 1 de octubre de 2026.




How to apply

Comparte tu CV y evidencia concreta de algo que hayas construido. Puede ser un repositorio de GitHub, un producto en producción, una demo, una automatización o un proyecto privado que puedas explicar durante la entrevista.

title: SDET
skills: Partner with engineering and product teams to understand business workflows, system architecture, integrations, and technical dependencies. Independently identify quality risks and define an appropriate testing and automation strategy.

Architect Scalable Automation Solutions. Design, develop, maintain, and continuously improve reliable automation frameworks and reusable test utilities for modern web applications, APIs, backend services, and integrated systems using technologies such as Playwright, TypeScript, and Python.
Build the appropriate balance of API, integration, component, contract, data, and end-to-end automation, minimizing unnecessary dependence on UI-level testing.

Participate in discovery, requirements refinement, technical design, and architecture discussions to identify edge cases, dependencies, testability concerns, and potential failure scenarios before development is complete.

Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish effective quality gates. Optimize execution through parallelization, tagging, test selection, environment management, reporting, and failure diagnostics.

Design robust API and integration validation for RESTful services and backend workflows, including request/response validation, authentication, error handling, service dependencies, and asynchronous processes.

Validate data across databases, APIs, files, and integrated systems using SQL and programmatic approaches. Verify data integrity, transformations, reconciliation, and complex backend processing when required.

Investigate failures using application logs, browser developer tools, network traces, API clients, database queries, and application telemetry. Distinguish between product defects, automation failures, test-data issues, infrastructure problems, and environment instability.

Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate test design, coding, debugging, documentation, and analysis while critically reviewing generated solutions and maintaining engineering standards.

5+ years of experience in an SDET, Software Engineer, Quality Engineer, Test Automation Engineer, or comparable engineering role, with experience delivering quality solutions for modern web applications, APIs, and integrated systems.

Strong software-development skills in at least one modern programming language. TypeScript/JavaScript or Python is strongly preferred. You should be comfortable designing maintainable software, working with existing codebases, debugging applications, and applying software-engineering principles rather than simply writing test scripts.

Ability to independently own quality engineering activities for a project or significant product area, proactively identifying problems and driving them to resolution without requiring detailed testing instructions. Ability to clearly communicate technical risks, constructively challenge assumptions, collaborate across technical and non-technical teams, and influence engineering decisions related to quality and testability.
Strong experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks for web applications and APIs. Hands-on experience with Playwright is strongly preferred.

Strong understanding of testing at different layers, including unit, component, API, integration, contract, data, and end-to-end testing, with the ability to determine which testing approach provides the most value for a given risk.

Strong experience testing REST APIs, JSON payloads, service integrations, backend workflows, and databases. Proficiency with SQL and experience validating data across integrated systems is highly valued.

Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent, with an understanding of automated quality gates and continuous delivery practices.
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
Strong working knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, coding standards, and collaborative software-development practices.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to take ambiguous requirements or complex system designs and independently identify risks, edge cases, failure scenarios, dependencies, and appropriate validation approaches.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

We ensure that teams across Product Support Operations and Risk Operations have the knowledge they need to master our products, provide gold standard support, and safeguard both Stripe and our users. We aspire to elevate the way our learners perceive us, positioning ourselves as a critical resource on their journey to growth through quality training that resonates with, and empowers, every individual.

What you’ll do

As a Training Program Manager within the Technical Enablement team, your role will be to develop training initiatives that enhance the capabilities of our Operations teams, specifically Product Support and Risk Operations. Our team takes pride in refining the Stripe experience for both our users and our global network of support specialists. By owning the strategic direction and execution of training programs, you'll play a crucial role in equipping operations associated with the knowledge and skills necessary for exceptional service delivery.

Responsibilities


Design learning curricula to help deliver the vision and strategy for the Stripe Operations training program
Convert business requirements into comprehensive training curricula and supportive content, tailored to the needs of our teams
Ensure the application of adult learning principles and systematic instructional design to create effective learning solutions, including online, classroom, virtual, and blended learning modalities
Design assessment methodologies aligned with leading accreditation frameworks and practices
Partner with business leaders across Operations to develop relevant training programs in accordance with the strategy you set out
Analyze metric data to evaluate high-priority topics that would benefit from the development of new training modules and measure training impact post-launch
Efficiently partner with cross-functional stakeholders on high-priority projects and initiatives, adapting swiftly to emerging needs and dedicating focused effort to ensure success
Proactively assess and respond to training demands in cases where there may be significant ambiguity or unknowns
Harmonize our training efforts across our Stripe Delivery Centers



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


3+ years of experience in driving training or enablement programs with prior instructional design or training exposure
Experience designing and developing training materials and content to include online/e-learning modules, instructor-led materials, job aids, online tutorials, multimedia products (video, graphic, audio), and other training materials
Experience using data collection, research, and analysis to evaluate project outcomes and improve individual and organizational performance
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders with varying priorities and drive creative solutions and commitment to a shared goal



Preferred Qualifications


Experience leveraging learning management systems and/or other content delivery platforms
An inquisitive approach to learning about new technologies, with a keen sense in identifying user and agent issues
The ability to distill complex information into clear, concise deliverables
Experience in identifying recurring issues faced by customers and specialists, and developing scalable training solutions
Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience giving presentations



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
About the job

🚀 Buscamos un/a Customer Support Specialist L1 en México para sumarse a AgendaPro.




AgendaPro es la plataforma líder en LATAM para gestionar agenda, pagos y crecimiento en negocios de belleza, salud y bienestar, con más de 12 años creciendo y respaldo de Y Combinator y una Serie B de US$35M.




Estamos en plena transformación: pasamos de un SaaS horizontal a un modelo de verticales con agentes de IA, y estamos armando los equipos que van a llevar estas nuevas líneas de negocio al mercado. Es una etapa temprana donde todavía hay muchísimo por construir, probar y escalar y queremos que seas parte desde el principio.




Buscamos gente con ganas de aprender, actitud resolutiva y vocación de servicio, que entienda que detrás de cada conversación hay un emprendedor confiando en nosotros.




📍 Modalidad híbrida – con esquema de turnos: días presenciales con entrada a las 09:00 y fines de semana remoto.




Tu desafío: Ser la primera línea de soporte vía chat (Intercom) y resolver los problemas de nuestros clientes con rapidez, claridad y empatía. Cada conversación bien resuelta es un cliente que se queda.




🚀 Qué harás / Responsabilidades:

• Atención en Intercom (tu cancha principal): gestionar tu bandeja de conversaciones, tomar casos y responder en tiempo real.

• Comunicarte con clientes por chat (canal principal) y, ocasionalmente, por mail, teléfono o videollamada.

• Ser el reflejo de la marca en cada mensaje: claro, empático y paciente, sobre todo con clientes poco tecnologizados.

• Resolver consultas de usabilidad guiando al cliente paso a paso dentro de AgendaPro.

• Crear y documentar tickets internos con todo el detalle cuando corresponda.

• Trabajar junto a Tecnología y Producto para que los errores se resuelvan rápido, sin perder nunca el seguimiento con el cliente.

• Cumplir las métricas del área: CSAT, tiempo de primera respuesta (FRT), tiempo de resolución y productividad diaria.

• Participar en capacitaciones, QA y mejora continua de flujos y respuestas.




Requisitos:

• Pasión real por el servicio al cliente: no descansas hasta dejar al usuario con su problema resuelto.

• Excelente comunicación escrita en español: sabes explicar lo complejo de forma simple.

• Habilidad tecnológica básica: navegadores, correo, hojas de cálculo y varias pestañas/herramientas abiertas a la vez sin marearte.

• Comodidad para revisar configuraciones y guiar al cliente en las suyas.

• Proactividad, paciencia, empatía y aguante para manejar varias conversaciones a la vez.

• Disponibilidad para el esquema de turnos (presencial con entrada a las 09:00 y remoto los fines de semana).




Suma puntos (no excluyente):

• Experiencia en atención al cliente, ventas o customer success en empresas de tecnología / SaaS.

• Conocimiento de herramientas tipo Intercom, Zendesk o CRMs.

• Nociones de web, APIs, redes o tecnología en general.

• Inglés intermedio.

The Impact You'll Make

As our Customer Claims Handling Specialist, you’ll play a key role in delivering a trusted and professional customer experience by managing claims and complaints from intake through closure. You will serve as the main coordination point between customers and internal teams, ensuring timely communication, accurate documentation, and effective follow-through across the entire claim-handling process.

At Danfoss, we support your growth through learning opportunities, global collaboration, and meaningful work. You’ll be part of an inclusive environment where well-being, teamwork, and continuous development are valued every day.

Your impact? You will help strengthen customer confidence, improve response consistency, and support quality excellence by ensuring claims are managed with urgency, transparency, and accuracy. Your work will contribute to stronger customer relationships, improved operational learning, and continuous improvement across the organization.

You’ll collaborate with Quality, Engineering, Operations, Field Service, Supply Chain, Sales, and Customer Service teams, taking ownership of claim coordination, communication, escalation tracking, and record integrity, helping us move toward a more customer-focused and efficient future.

Manage customer claims from intake through closure, ensuring accurate documentation, case ownership, milestone tracking, and timely communication.
Coordinate cross-functional teams including Site Quality, Engineering, Field Service, Operations, and commercial stakeholders to support investigations and corrective-action follow-up.

Working knowledge of 8D, containment, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, CAPA concepts, and quality management systems.
Strong communication, documentation, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders effectively.
A mindset of customer focus, collaboration, accountability, attention to detail, and continuous improvement within cross-functional and global environments.

We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

description:
About the job

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We're hiring the person who will own paid acquisition for our DTC channel as it moves from a controlled, governed starting point toward meaningful scale. This is fundamentally an economics role before it is a media-buying role: the person we hire will operate inside clear contribution and measurement guardrails, and will be trusted to leave budget unspent when the numbers don't support deploying it.

Recruiting this role does not itself authorize increased ad spend—spend scales in steps, gated by sustained contribution performance, not by hire date. If you're energized by proving out an account methodically and scaling only what's actually working, this role is built for you.




ABOUT US

Ecotero LLC operates five private-label brands led by DECOLURE in premium bedding and home textiles. Amazon is the mature channel at $18M+ annually across roughly 703 SKUs. TikTok Shop does roughly $4.5M and is growing. DTC on Shopify is early.

We are a 27-person distributed team. The analytical infrastructure here is unusual for a business this size: SKU-level COGS across the full catalogue, daily API pipelines into PostgreSQL, competitor tracking, and AI operational agents that produce weekly audit drafts, anomaly flags and performance reports for your review.




SCOPE OF THIS ROLE

This role reports directly to the Head of DTC. You'll own the ad accounts and day-to-day media decisions, but spend authorization is governed separately and is not automatically unlocked by this hire—increases are tied to sustained, measured contribution performance.

You'll work closely with the Lifecycle and Retention Manager, whose cohort and LTV reporting sets your CAC ceiling, and with the Paid Social Creative Producer, who supplies and iterates on creative based on your test results.




You do not own landing page development or on-site conversion optimization directly, though you'll partner closely with whoever does to make sure traffic and landing experience are aligned.

As the channel matures, this role's scope is expected to grow into a broader acquisition function with additional specialists; today, it's a hands-on, individually owned seat.




WHAT YOU OWN

Meta and Google as core paid channels, expanding to Pinterest, YouTube, or others as they qualify on the numbers.
Account structure, campaign architecture, audience strategy, bid strategy, and day-to-day budget pacing.
The daily discipline of deciding where the next marginal dollar goes, including the discipline to leave it unspent when the account doesn't support it.
Operating within a defined spend gate tied to sustained contribution or blended MER performance — spend scales in governed steps as performance clears agreed thresholds, not on a fixed schedule.
Blended MER and contribution economics after COGS, fulfillment, returns, and media cost, not platform-reported ROAS alone.
Applying a realistic haircut to platform-reported return metrics before planning against them.
CAC ceilings set from the lifecycle team's cohort and LTV data, not from a platform dashboard metric.
A structured creative testing calendar in partnership with the Creative Producer — every test has a stated hypothesis, a minimum sample size, and a kill criterion set before launch.
Winner scaling and fatigue monitoring: tracking frequency, CPM drift, and knowing when a winning ad is done.
Incrementality testing, geo holdouts or spend-down tests on a regular cadence, and understanding how much of reported non-brand conversion is actually incremental versus cannibalized branded search.
Working with the CRO/merchandising owner to ensure traffic and landing pages are matched, even though you don't own the page itself.
Clear, regular reporting on account performance, test results, and the reasoning behind every scale-up or pull-back decision.




REQUIRED EVIDENCE

Required:

You have personally held a blended MER or contribution target on an account with $100,000 or more in monthly governed spend, sustained over a period of at least six months, and can name the brand, the dates, and the results.
You can describe a specific time you reduced or stopped spend on something that looked good on the dashboard, the threshold you used, who disagreed, and what happened afterward.

You can commit to substantial same-day overlap with US Eastern hours — pacing and budget decisions happen daily.

Direct experience partnering with an in-house or contracted creative producer on a structured test calendar.

description:
About the job

Creative Content Strategist | YouTube & Long-Form Video

Remote | Part-Time | 20 Hours/Week




About the Role

We are looking for a highly creative Creative Content Strategist to take ownership of the strategy and creative direction behind a growing YouTube channel focused on business, marketing, entrepreneurship, and education.




This is a behind-the-scenes creative role. You will be responsible for continuously researching new ideas, developing original video concepts, creating stories and narratives, writing scripts, building storyboards, researching filming locations, and helping shape what each video should look and feel like before the founders step in front of the camera.

The ideal candidate understands YouTube content, storytelling, business, and digital marketing and knows how to turn business expertise into compelling content that people actually want to watch.




Key Responsibilities

Own the creative strategy and content planning for the YouTube channel.
Research and develop new, original video ideas on an ongoing basis.
Study successful YouTube channels and identify formats, storytelling approaches, hooks, and concepts that can be adapted to the brand.
Develop compelling video concepts around business, entrepreneurship, marketing, and real-world business stories.
Create storylines and narratives that make educational content engaging and entertaining.
Write and structure scripts for long-form YouTube videos.
Develop storyboards and detailed creative directions for each video.
Determine the hook, structure, pacing, key talking points, and overall narrative of each piece.
Interview or collaborate with the founders to extract stories, experiences, insights, and expertise that can become strong content.
Research interesting entrepreneurs, businesses, trends, case studies, and potential collaboration opportunities.
Identify and reach out to potential entrepreneurs or business owners for collaborations and guest appearances.
Research visually interesting filming locations in Miami, including hotels, venues, high-rise spaces, businesses, and other unique environments.
Provide creative direction for filming setups, locations, environments, and overall visual presentation.
Prepare the founders with everything they need before filming so they can execute the content efficiently.
Collaborate with the long-form video editor and clearly communicate the intended creative direction.
Help establish a repeatable YouTube content production system and maintain an organized content pipeline.
Develop approximately one long-form YouTube video per week, with additional shorter long-form content as needed.




Content Focus:

The content will primarily revolve around:

Business and entrepreneurship
Digital marketing
Business growth and strategy
Educational content
Entrepreneurial stories and interviews
Case studies and business lessons
Personal branding and founder-led content
Interesting business trends and real-world stories

The goal is to create content that educates, entertains, and builds authority, rather than feeling like traditional advertising.




What We're Looking For

Strong understanding of YouTube content strategy and storytelling.
Demonstrated experience creating or developing long-form YouTube content.
Excellent creative instincts and the ability to consistently generate fresh, original ideas.
Strong scripting and storytelling skills.
Ability to think visually and imagine how a video should look before it is filmed.
Understanding of hooks, retention, pacing, narrative structure, and audience psychology.
Strong research skills and curiosity about business, entrepreneurship, marketing, and financial topics.
Basic understanding of digital marketing and business concepts.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with founders.
Organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of the creative process.
Ability to research and identify interesting filming locations and environments.
Comfortable researching and reaching out to entrepreneurs for potential collaborations.
Experience with B2B content marketing, educational content, consulting, podcasting, or founder-led content is a plus.
A portfolio of YouTube videos or relevant long-form content is required.




Important Role Clarification

Video editing is NOT the primary responsibility of this position.




A dedicated video editor will handle the editing. Your responsibility is to define what should be created and how it should be created—from the initial idea and research through the story, script, storyboard, filming plan, and creative direction.

You will essentially act as the creative director and strategic brain behind the YouTube channel.

You do not need to live in Miami. However, you should be comfortable researching Miami locations remotely using tools such as Google Maps, venue websites, and other online resources.




Experience

We are open to candidates across different experience levels.

A highly experienced YouTube strategist is welcome, but we are equally interested in junior or mid-level candidates who demonstrate exceptional creative thinking, strong storytelling ability, and a genuine understanding of what makes YouTube content compelling.

Your portfolio and creative instincts matter more than a specific number of years of experience.




Schedule

Part-Time
Approximately 20 hours/week to start
Flexible remote schedule
Opportunity to increase hours and responsibilities as the content operation grows

About the job

At Jellyfish we believe that our individual differences are our greatest assets. We are passionate about empowering every employee to reach their full potential and contribute their unique perspectives to our collaborative environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and firmly believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce drives innovation and leads to better solutions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other personal characteristics that make them who they are.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly analytical and creative-minded Creative Intelligence Analyst to join our team. This role is designed to bridge the gap between media performance and creative production. You will be responsible for dissecting creative performance data to understand why certain ads perform better than others, translating those insights into actionable strategies for our creative and media teams. You will work closely with our Creative/Pencil Lead and Media Buyers to optimize our creative output based on rigorous data analysis.

Key Responsibilities


 Creative Performance Analysis & Reporting
Analyze the performance of creative assets across various platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.) to identify winning patterns and elements.
Evaluate creative components such as hooks, visuals, copy, and CTAs to determine their impact on key performance indicators (KPIs) like CTR, CPA, and ROAS.
Build and maintain comprehensive dashboards and reports that focus specifically on creative efficacy.
 Strategic Bridge & Briefing
Act as the primary liaison between the Media/Data teams and the Creative/Production teams.
Translate media performance data into creative "lessons learned" and actionable creative briefs for future production.
Collaborate with the Creative/Pencil Lead to integrate AI-driven insights into the creative workflow.
 Testing & Optimization Frameworks
Develop and manage a robust creative testing roadmap, including A/B testing and multivariate testing protocols.
Provide data-backed recommendations for creative iterations and optimizations.
Oversee the metadata tagging process for creative assets to ensure granular data collection and analysis.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration
Participate in regular cross-departmental syncs to align creative production with media buying strategies.
Educate the creative team on performance metrics and how their work impacts the bottom line.
Stay ahead of industry trends and platform updates to ensure our creative strategies remain cutting-edge.


Requirements & Skills

Experience: 3-5 years of experience in media analysis, digital marketing, or a performance-driven creative role. Advanced English proficiency. 

Analytical Skills: Proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, Google Data Studio, Tableau) and platform native analytics.

Platform Knowledge: Deep understanding of Paid Social and Programmatic ads platforms

Creative Intuition: A strong grasp of storytelling, visual design principles, and what resonates with audiences on social media.

Tool Proficiency: Experience with AI-driven creative tools (e.g., Pencil) and creative management platforms is highly desirable.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Savings fund: You'll save 5% of your monthly income and Jellyfish will contribute the same amount you save to your savings fund.

HireHawk builds high-performing remote teams for U.S. and Canadian companies by connecting great people with meaningful work, no matter where they live. We’re hiring this role on behalf of a fast-growing direct-to-consumer haircare brand that takes site experience seriously and wants a dedicated owner for conversion and on-site performance.




We're looking for an Ecommerce Manager who owns the on-site and channel execution across our key platforms. You'll drive CRO on our Shopify storefront, manage and optimize product pages on TikTok Shop and Amazon, run email campaign sends, and keep the operational layer of our ecommerce engine running cleanly.




You'll work closely with the Director of Growth and our retention agency on email flows and campaigns, your job is execution and iteration, not just ideation. If you like seeing your work ship fast, move metrics, and actually matter, this is the role.




Responsibilities:

Site CRO & Shopify

Own conversion rate optimization across the Shopify storefront PDPs, collection pages, checkout flow, homepage
Run A/B tests and on-site experiments; manage tooling and interpret results
Manage Shopify app ecosystem including upsell/cross-sell, reviews, subscriptions, bundles, and site speed tools
Maintain integrations and troubleshoot issues across apps, pixels, and data layers
Coordinate with creative team to brief and deploy updated imagery, copy, and UGC across PDPs

TikTok Shop

Own PDP optimization on TikTok Shop titles, bullets, imagery, A+ content, category/attribute setup
Monitor TikTok Shop storefront performance and flag issues to the broader team
Coordinate with the content and affiliate team to ensure product pages are dialed in to support creator traffic
Stay current on TikTok Shop feature releases and surface relevant updates

Amazon

Assist with Amazon listing optimization titles, bullets, A+ content, backend keywords, imagery
Work alongside internal stakeholders and agency contacts to implement updates and maintain listing health
Flag suppressed listings, content issues, or policy flags and coordinate resolution

Email Marketing

Execute campaign sends end-to-end: build, QA, schedule, and deploy in Klaviyo
Partner with Director of Growth and retention agency on flow strategy — your role is hands-on implementation
Manage segmentation logic, list hygiene, and send cadence
Pull post-send reporting and surface performance insights

Tooling & Operations

Own the review platform — ensure review collection, moderation, and syndication are running
Leverage AI tools for copywriting, content optimization, and productivity
Maintain clean documentation across SOPs, app settings, and platform configurations
Support new channel or integration launches as the business scales

Requirements

Must-Have:

2 to 4 years in a DTC ecommerce role, you've lived inside Shopify and know it cold
Hands-on Klaviyo experience: you've built campaigns, managed flows, and pulled your own reporting
Worked on TikTok Shop in some capacity, even if not the primary owner
Basic Amazon Seller Central familiarity listing updates, A+ content, suppression troubleshooting
Comfortable with the Shopify app ecosystem: you know what tools exist, how they talk to each other, and how to triage when something breaks
CRO mindset: you think about the customer journey, not just the task in front of you
Detail-oriented and execution-focused you ship, you follow up, you close the loop
Comfortable using AI tools to move faster (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, etc.)
Strong communicator who can work cross-functionally with creative, growth, and external partners

Nice-to-Have

Experience at a beauty, wellness, or CPG DTC brand
Familiarity with affiliate or influencer-adjacent ecommerce (TikTok Shop affiliates, LTK, etc.)
Basic HTML/CSS for email template edits
Experience with tools like Elevar, Triple Whale, or similar attribution/analytics platforms
Comfort pulling and interpreting data in Google Sheets or Looker

Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)

Role Overview:

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Biology Expert (PhD/Master’s) to work on a full-time basis. You will design and solve challenging biology problems to probe the limitations of large language models and collaborate with LLM researchers to align problem types with evaluation goals. This role helps fine-tune large language models using strong analytical and English comprehension skills.




Key Responsibilities:

• Design and solve complex biology problems to assess the limitations of large language models.

• Develop high-quality, step-by-step solutions with clear and rigorous reasoning.

• Collaborate with LLM researchers to align problem types with evaluation goals, especially in areas where models typically struggle.

• Contribute to defining new evaluation benchmarks based on biology curricula spanning early undergraduate to PhD-level topics.

• Break down complex biological concepts into simple, clear explanations while working efficiently.




Required Skills & Qualifications:

• PhD or Master’s degree in Biology or a related field.

• Strong analytical and research skills in biology.

• Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.

• Creative and lateral thinking abilities to solve challenging problems.

• Excellent structured communication and collaboration skills in a remote setting.

• Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment.




More About the Opportunity:

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the research services industry, contributing to the advancement of AI systems through high-quality data and rigorous evaluation. The projects will help you learn how to leverage AI to enhance analytical skills.




Equal Opportunity Employer:

We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.




Apply Now!

Sobre Brother

Brother es una compañía global con más de 115 años de historia, reconocida por desarrollar soluciones innovadoras para el hogar, la oficina y la industria.

En Brother México, con más de 30 años de presencia en el país, trabajamos bajo nuestra promesa “At your side”, buscando simplificar y enriquecer la vida de nuestros clientes, colaboradores y comunidades.




Nuestra cultura está impulsada por cuatro comportamientos clave: Responsabilidad, Autenticidad, Audacia y Excelencia, promoviendo un entorno diverso, inclusivo y colaborativo.




Sobre la posición

Buscamos un/a Analista de Marketing para apoyar el análisis y ejecución de las estrategias de marketing de nuestro portafolio de retail, contribuyendo al crecimiento de ventas y al posicionamiento de la marca Brother en el mercado.

Esta posición tendrá exposición a diferentes áreas del negocio y trabajará de manera cercana con Marketing, Ventas, clientes y equipos regionales/globales, combinando análisis de información, conocimiento de producto y ejecución comercial.




¿Qué harás?

📊 Análisis de producto y mercado

Analizar productos, precios, TCO, competencia y posicionamiento en los diferentes canales de venta.
Dar seguimiento a tendencias de mercado y Market Share, identificando oportunidades y riesgos.
Apoyar el análisis para lanzamientos de nuevos productos, posicionamiento y estrategias por canal.
Recopilar y analizar información relevante de clientes, mercado y competencia.




📈 Análisis comercial y desempeño

Dar seguimiento y analizar indicadores de Sell-In, Sell-Out, inventario, Forecast, crecimiento y mix de producto.
Preparar reportes y presentaciones sobre desempeño de productos y canales.
Apoyar análisis de GP, rentabilidad y ROI de productos y acciones comerciales.
Dar seguimiento a precios, price protection, fondos de marketing y gastos del portafolio.
Apoyar la preparación de información para procesos de Budget, Net Sales, GP y Forecast.




🤝 Soporte a Ventas y clientes

Colaborar con el equipo de Ventas en la ejecución y seguimiento de estrategias de Sell-Out.
Preparar briefs, presentaciones, comparativos y materiales de apoyo comercial.
Brindar soporte de marketing y producto a la fuerza de ventas.
Apoyar capacitaciones de producto para clientes internos y externos.
Participar en visitas de campo y contacto con clientes para recopilar información e identificar oportunidades.
Dar seguimiento y canalizar adecuadamente requerimientos o temas técnicos reportados por clientes.




🚀 Marketing & Demand Generation

Apoyar la planeación, ejecución y seguimiento de campañas de marketing y acciones comerciales.
Colaborar en la organización de eventos y actividades con clientes y canales.
Dar soporte a iniciativas de marketing digital y e-commerce, incluyendo website, contenido digital, redes sociales y product pages.
Dar seguimiento a los resultados de campañas y preparar análisis que permitan identificar oportunidades de mejora.
Coordinar materiales de marketing, traducciones y herramientas comerciales.




🌎 Colaboración regional y global

Apoyar la comunicación con equipos de Brother USA y Brother Japón relacionada con productos, lanzamientos y materiales de marketing.
Dar seguimiento a información y especificaciones de nuevos productos y empaques.
Apoyar procesos de pricing y Tender Support.
Participar en proyectos y actividades que pueden requerir viajes nacionales e internacionales.




¿Qué buscamos?

Licenciatura concluida en Marketing, Administración de Empresas, Negocios, Mercadotecnia o áreas afines.
Experiencia en Marketing, Product Marketing, Trade Marketing, Business Analysis o áreas comerciales relacionadas.
Interés y capacidad para trabajar con información comercial y de mercado.
Conocimiento de conceptos como Sell-In, Sell-Out, Forecast, Market Share y Pricing.
Manejo de Microsoft Office, especialmente Excel y PowerPoint.
Inglés avanzado, oral y escrito.
Disponibilidad para realizar viajes nacionales e internacionales.




Competencias clave

Buscamos una persona con:

🔎 Capacidad analítica y atención al detalle.
📈 Orientación a resultados y al negocio.
💡 Curiosidad y capacidad para identificar oportunidades.
🤝 Colaboración y trabajo en equipo.
💬 Comunicación efectiva.
📋 Planeación y organización.
🚀 Proactividad y aprendizaje continuo.
🎯 Capacidad para transformar datos en insights y acciones.




¿Por qué Brother?

Queremos que nuestros colaboradores puedan desarrollarse profesionalmente mientras mantienen un balance saludable entre su vida personal y profesional.

Entre nuestros beneficios y prácticas de trabajo encontrarás:

🏠 Esquema híbrido de trabajo.
🩺 Seguro de gastos médicos y seguro de vida.
💰 Programa de ahorro y beneficios financieros.
👨 👩 👧 Beneficios y permisos enfocados en momentos importantes para nuestros colaboradores y sus familias.
📚 Programas y recursos de aprendizaje y desarrollo.
👕 Código de vestimenta casual.
📅 Días adicionales de descanso durante el año.
🚗 Estacionamiento en nuestra oficina de Santa Fe.




Nuestra cultura

Nuestra misión es cumplir nuestra promesa “At your side”, simplificando y enriqueciendo la vida de nuestros clientes, colaboradores y comunidades.

Nos guiamos por nuestros impulsores culturales — Responsabilidad, Autenticidad, Audacia y Excelencia — que definen cómo colaboramos, tomamos decisiones y generamos resultados.

📍 Nuestra oficina corporativa en México está ubicada en Santa Fe, Ciudad de México.




Igualdad de oportunidades

Brother es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y estamos comprometidos con construir un entorno inclusivo donde todas las personas sean respetadas y valoradas.

Damos la bienvenida a postulantes de todos los orígenes y no discriminamos por motivos de raza, género, edad, discapacidad, orientación sexual ni por cualquier otra condición protegida por la legislación aplicable.

¿Te apasiona el marketing, disfrutas analizar información y quieres desarrollar tu carrera combinando producto, datos y estrategia comercial en una compañía global? Queremos conocerte.

Uno de los puestos clave para el alcance de nuestras metas es el de Associate Sponsorship Marketing. Te contamos más sobre las actividades de esta vacante.
